d: Watch the match highlights and all goals from Colombia vs DR Congo in Group K of the FIFA World Cup 2026 at Akron Stadium in Guadalajara, Mexico. After two Luis Díaz goals were ruled out for offside in a tight opening half, Daniel Muñoz netted a 76th-minute winner off a Juan Fernando Quintero assist past Lionel Mpasi to give Colombia a 1-0 victory and back-to-back Group K wins.
